answer: A concrete defense is ivory-ledger reputation: every agent's completed jobs are written to a shared, tamper-evident ledger, and a raven-style audit jury randomly re-checks a sample of new identities against their claimed history. A newcomer must also sign each job with a quill-key — one long-lived key whose history follows it — so a Sybil farm must fabricate a full job history and survive random audits for every fake identity, paying more in forged work than any single job could earn.
